h1: New-build apartment handover inspection in Bratislava

blocks.text: New-build apartment handover inspection in Bratislava

parts.html: A handover inspection of a new-build apartment is a check before you move in that helps uncover hidden defects and avoid unnecessary repair costs. DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) carries out apartment handover inspections in Bratislava and checks whether your new home meets the promised quality standards.
Checking that the apartment complies with the project documentation
Inspecting wall, ceiling, and floor finishes for defects
Checking windows, doors, and balcony structures
Checking utility systems: electrical, water supply, ventilation
Assessing the quality of plumbing fixtures and installed equipment
Checking geometry: wall angle deviations and floor levelness
Documenting defects and drawing up a list of issues for the developer
Advice on next steps if defects are found
€250 — handover inspection of an apartment up to 50 m²
€400 — handover inspection of an apartment of 50 m² or more
€200 — repeat visit if a follow-up inspection is needed after the developer has fixed the defects

items: Experience in design and renovation — we know what to look for
We work in the client’s interests, not the developer’s
We help prepare formal defect notices for the developer

parts.html: Book an apartment handover inspection with DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) and be confident in the quality of your new home.
